Indian Railways Retires Five Officers Prematurely After Review

Indian Railways has recommended the premature retirement of five Group 'A' officers following a detailed review of their service records. The decision was made after assessing their performance and suitability for continued service. The specific reasons for the retirement recommendation were not detailed in the coverage but followed a comprehensive evaluation process.
